brief: A note-taking app in 3D space — recent notes float near, old ones drift away, connections are threads

dominant_strengths: Depth metaphor reads instantly: scale, opacity and blur convey recency-as-proximity without needing labels or legends
Restrained dark palette with subtle warm glow on active notes creates cohesive atmosphere and gentle hierarchy
Thread connections imply a knowledge graph, giving the spatial gimmick semantic purpose beyond decoration
dominant_weaknesses: Toolbar is generic rectangular chrome floating in a 3D world — breaks the spatial fiction and feels bolted on
Connection threads are thin, low-contrast, and ambiguous; relationship type, direction, and weight are unreadable
Recent/Archive axis label is weak typographically and competes poorly with cards; the gradient bar lacks affordance
fix_priorities: Redesign the top toolbar to feel spatial — translucent, perspective-aware, or recede with the canvas
Strengthen thread semantics: vary thickness, color-by-topic, add subtle directional flow or hover reveal
Treat the Recent↔Archive axis as a true z-ruler with typographic depth, not a side gradient
Tighten card typography hierarchy (title weight, metadata size) so far cards remain legible when scaled
rationale.norman_balance: Strong reflective concept and decent visceral mood, but behavioral layer is underspecified — navigation, zoom, and thread interaction are unclear.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes — proximity-as-recency and threads-as-connections directly express the brief, though the spatial system stops at the chrome edges.
